mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals increased economic activity and supply, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which reduces uncertainty and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% each within two months signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.3% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals a contractionary environment, which increases costs and reduces supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreased and FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.
